theorems.name: Submission.cbr_smm_strip_distribution_function
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Set (Euclid P)) (a b : ℝ), Continuous f → μ (G ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}) < ∞ → ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, Monotone F ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (F b - F a) = μ (G ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ h ∈ Ioo 0 (t - a), μ (G ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (F t - F (t - h))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
